mapper.select: SELECT spod.* FROM scm_purchase_order_detail spod INNER JOIN scm_purchase_order spo ON spod.purchase_id = spo.id and spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and spo.data_status = 1 WHERE spod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND spod.apply_purchase_detail_id = #{applyPurchaseDetail} GROUP BY spod.id

SELECT spod.* FROM scm_purchase_order_detail spod INNER JOIN scm_purchase_order spo ON spod.purchase_id = spo.id and spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE spod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND spo.review_status = 2 AND spod.apply_purchase_detail_id in
#{applyDetailId}

select spod.purchase_id as id, IFNULL(sum(spod.actual_received_mete),0) as mete from scm_purchase_order_detail spod left join scm_purchase_order spo on spod.purchase_id = spo.id where spod.bool_delete_enum = 0 and spo.review_status = 2
and spod.purchase_id in
#{purchaseId}
group by spod.purchase_id
